edges.rationale: The ported C++ scheduler's Dispatch() reads the next ready task off the queue on its first branch; the Rust port carries the same call.

The origin oracle's Dispatch() requeues unfinished work via queue_.push_back() before returning; the port's own call is on a field receiver, so a syntactic extractor sees a possible-dispatch rather than a resolved edge, same as the Mode R pilot.

Shutdown() in the origin repository drains the queue through a virtual dispatch table (an IQueueSink*); no static call site exists in the port either, since the port keeps the same trait-object indirection. This is the edge Mode P's own differential-testing oracle would need to catch, and it is exactly the shape the omission metric exists for.
